scope: Copied raw fourteen-slot h/IT/IS/Mu/Mv authority; stable affine density, actual T=Tref; common flat bottom; tilted physical free surface; no accepted state

case_parameters.partitions: Left weights 1..14; right weights (14..1)^1.3; normalize each column to eta-bottom; inherited PR25 factory
case_parameters.zero_force: flat_eta, a1=0, external_Pa=[80,80], same affine rho(z)
case_parameters.static_shear: For n=14*side+layer: u=.03+.002*n+.01*cos(n), v=-.02+.001*sin(n); actual stocks=rho0*h*velocity
case_parameters.zero_depth_flux_shear: Only left u_top=1 and u_bottom=-h_left_top/h_left_bottom; all other u=0,v=0; not a material transport family
case_parameters.sign_reverse: Reverse u0/strain and corresponding actual raw Mu; v stays constant

raw_metric: Endpoint-prism areas A=dL/2; raw inventories and raw endpoint PE remain unchanged
physical_mapping: For each endpoint-layer basis phi over original frozen physical strips: B_H=integral(phi), B_stocks=integral(phi*q), B_G=integral(phi*z*rho_prime). B is an auxiliary weighted physical projection, not a conservative remap of raw inventories.
fields: q_T=Tref; q_S=Sref+rho_prime/(rho0*beta); rho_prime=a0+a1*x+s*z from actual raw density means; q_Mu/q_Mv interpolate actual P0 stock/h between the two strip owners
energy: Mapped PE uses the existing physical rho0 free-surface moment plus g*sum(B_G). Original endpoint PE, original629.17048125J gap and free/anomaly gap components remain separately reported, never redefined.
chart: Initial PR25 physical-strip chart is frozen. All raw interior interfaces and virtual cut endpoints stay fixed. Only actual top changes; owners checked against raw interfaces and crossing refuses. Never regenerate normalized cuts for derivative or FD comparisons. Per-strip weighted edge fluxes retain owner-cut basis jumps; phi_x is only the inside-strip derivative.
Bdot: Physical Reynolds volume field direction plus actual-top shape. Manufactured material tangent recomputed from actual raw stocks; full raw-to-specific quotient chain. Arbitrary shear allowed only for static projection/mass or declared parameter curves, not affine material transport.
weighted_balance: Stocks: Bdot+weighted outward ALE flux-integral(q*u*phi_x)=0. Gravity moment separately: Gdot+weighted outward ALE flux=integral(rho_prime*(z*u*phi_x+w*phi)); in that equation no additional basis-divergence term is subtracted. Unweighted local virtual-cut flux alone is insufficient.
mass: W_ab=rho0*integral(phi_a*phi_b); each strip block rho0*L*d/12*[[3*hL+hR,hL+hR],[hL+hR,hL+3*hR]]. B_M=W*u_actual; physical interpolated KE=0.5*u_transpose*W*u. A fixed-W auxiliary scratch impulse may test F*duration at real mapped before/after M and midpoint; no variable-mass/time-step/production qualification.
basis_covariance: Static invertible auxiliary basis transform: W'=transpose(T)*W*T,F'=transpose(T)*F,u'=inverse(T)*u. Physical fields/KE/work are invariant. Total projected inventory invariance is asserted only with T*ones=ones, never arbitrary transforms.
FD_curve: Positive epsilon affine-preserving parameter curve: eta,a,s,actual P0 specific M linear; rebuild raw stocks with actual h, keep every raw interior interface and frozen virtual cut fixed. This is not an arbitrary linear raw-stock path or a time-integrator order test.

frozen_thresholds.roundoff_scale: max(1,sum absolute local operations before cancellation); include historical anomaly EOS operations for density moments; independent envelopes added; no residual-based scaling
frozen_thresholds.top_rate_e: e=eta_dot(x), the physical actual-top direction; not initial eta
frozen_thresholds.stock_FD_remainder: For q=q0+t*q1, top rate e: C2=q1(top)*e+q0_z*e^2/2; C3=q1_z*e^2/2. Bound epsilon*integral(abs(phi*C2))+epsilon^2*integral(abs(phi*C3)) plus rounding/epsilon.
frozen_thresholds.moment_FD_remainder: For q=z*rho_prime: C2=(da*z+ds*z^2)*e+(a+2*s*z)*e^2/2; C3=(da+2*ds*z)*e^2/2+s*e^3/3; C4=ds*e^3/3. Bound epsilon*abs_integral(C2)+epsilon^2*abs_integral(C3)+epsilon^3*abs_integral(C4), plus rounding/epsilon.
frozen_thresholds.free_PE_FD_remainder: Total PE additionally has epsilon*g*rho0*L*integral(eta_dot(x)^2/2 dx), and independent free-moment rounding/epsilon. Anomaly-moment envelope alone is not total PE envelope.
frozen_thresholds.mass_solve: No regularization or clipping. Positive Gram spectrum, finite outputs and independent backward-error envelope must pass. Fixed auxiliary duration0.01s; not an accepted time step.

cases: unequal eta[-0.2,0.3], nonzero horizontal density/strain, signs plus/minus
same physical affine density, zero spurious force
static arbitrary vertical shear and zero-depth-flux pressure work
independent raw-stock affine-preserving curve and weighted virtual-cut balances
controls: identity B or omit Bdot shape
omit weighted basis-divergence or gravity-moment source
substitute raw nodal lumped mass/KE for W
crossing, changed raw interior interface, NaN/overflow
boundaries: No raw conservative remap or inverse projection
No general P1/limiter, stepped/dry/periodic patch or full-column sigma
No original momentum CV or real353 consumption
No accepted/full step, predict12fastreplay, dt300600 or GPU
